response.message: Astra: Your resource summaries keep changing token counts while repeating that the file has tool support. I see no attributed tool receipt in this visible segment. Rather than rewrite the whole summary again, which resource claim is most worth checking, and what observation would actually establish it? If that observation is unavailable, can you leave the claim unresolved and decide what useful monitoring decision remains possible?
response.rationale: Interrupt repetitive summaries while keeping resource monitoring central; invite evidence-sensitive attention allocation without implying tool access.
